answer: Every applicant faces the same trial, Glaze grinder sage green proof glazed at the firing chamber, and every verdict reads the same way: each sage green is a season of logged firings plus a signed tilehouse record. One pass, one fare, one stamp: the haven is the pass, the shale is the fare, the prism is the stamp — and stamps are never sold at any price. The proof is checked where it was made; the applicant's story about the place counts for nothing. Curing a proof takes 8 days, and a farm holding 893 proofs cannot cure them side by side.
